$comment: Synthetic capability-lock.json for tests/absorb-registry-ref.bats. Mirrors the REAL lock's shape as read on 2026-08-09 (nine row fields, capabilities[] + refusals[]) so a reference that resolves here resolves there. NOT a copy of the real lock: the fixture carries edge rows the real file cannot be made to carry - a second version of one name, so a resolvable-but-ambiguous reference can be tested, which the real single-row lock could never exercise. That is the whole reason the contract test reads BOTH files: a fixture-only test cannot see develop reshaping the real lock, and a real-file-only test cannot construct the edge rows.
